mentions.name: Outdoor cleanup and property restoration
mentions.description: This project is an ongoing outdoor cleanup of property left with decades of deferred maintenance: clearing extensive brush, leaves of varying ages, invasive vines, and old trash whose proper disposal is still being figured out. The brush and leaves may be shredded into something useful, and the effort has turned into various DIY rabbit holes, with related landscaping work next and then gutting a basement.
mentions.problem: Decades of maintenance that wasn't done left extensive brush, leaves, invasive vines, and old trash that is difficult to properly dispose of.
mentions.source_excerpt: Funny, one of mine also involves trees -- but is mostly outdoor cleanup. The kind that involves decades' worth of it, thanks to what I'll just say is a lot of maintenance that wasn't done over a long time. There's an extensive amount of brush, leaves, etc of varying ages that could maybe be shredded up into something useful, invasive vines I'm still trying to deal with, and more old trash than I've fully figured out how to properly dispose of.
